title: Much Better Raids
description: This datapack or mod makes raids much better.
body:
This datapack or mod makes raids much better.
In beta you can find only one change.

First boss
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Raid Captains are now bosses. They uses crossbows that
shoots flamed arrows and they can summon vindicators.
If you will not kill it in 1 minute and 40 seconds, he
will get into his second phase.
https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/208f27bc26a5dc28ad601b1a29cf8c934ba38e9f.png

In second phase Raid Captain will get passive regeneration.
https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f214ce83dccfb41c7f65d88d4bd89f6ff6ad37c.png

More mobs and changed raids will come soon.
